::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** May 5th 1888  
**From:** Torquay  
**Manuscript:** MS Winchester City Council, Historic Resources Centre LH3803.1
:::

My dear [Miss Barlee](people/person_108.qmd)

The [Bishop of Madagascar](people/person_2344.qmd) has sent me this sad history of devastation asking to have it made known in [the Net](organizations/other_94.qmd), so I send it to you direct.[^1]  It has wandered a little as I am making visits in Devonshire but I hope to be at home by the end of the month.

yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Evidently Ellen Barlee, writer, social worker and contributor to *MP*had succeeded Anne Mackenzie as editor of the missionary journal *The Net*.  The first Anglican Bishop of Madagascar, the Rt. Rev. Robert Kestell Cornish (1824-1909), was consecrated in 1874. His brother-in-law taught at Winchester College and was a friend of CMY's.
